bundle.shortDescription: A retro platformer series: Episode 1, The Cocoa Caper.
bundle.longDescription: Lieutenant Fizz is a series of Keen-style platformers with a 16-colour EGA palette. Episode 1, The Cocoa Caper, sends Ben "Lieutenant Fizz" Blaze to Planet Zargoth in a spaghetti-and-meatballs flying saucer to rescue his cousin Billy from the Zargs. It runs on the Liminal Retro Engine, with controller and touch support, rumble and haptics.
